A.line: Newton was sitting under an apple tree.

B.line: An apple fell on his head.

C.line: The boy rode his horse to the village.

D.line: Einstein said to his friend, time is relative.

E.line: Geeta and her brother Arun walked to the village with two boys.

F.line: Geeta asked Arun, are you tired?

G.line: Ravi picked up an apple and walked to the tree.

H.line: He put the apple under the tree, climbed it and sat on a branch.

I.line: Then he jumped off the tree.

J.line: Meena came, and Ravi gave her the apple.

K.line: Meena threw the apple to the boy.

L.line: The boy picked up a stone and pushed a cart.

M.line: He dropped the stone and walked away.
